title: Women's 400m Hurdles World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' women's 400mH event ranking as of 10 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. Equal scores share a displayed rank, while the source assigns sequential places. This dated snapshot covers only the top ten and the live source may change.
